NDP level definitions

Source: R/ndp.R
NDP_LEVELS.Rd

Each level defines its Fibonacci weight, cumulative confidence, and the data sources that characterize it.

Usage

NDP_LEVELS

Format

A list of 5 elements, each with: ndp, key, name, fibonacci, confidence, sources.
